title: Chapter 2711 - 90: Campaign_2
content:
Chapter 2711: Chapter 90: Campaign_2

This indicates that his Divine Sense has indeed improved significantly, but this "quantitative change" in Divine Sense has not yet accumulated enough for a "qualitative change" to break through the bottleneck.

Mo Hua has a strong premonition.

Probably after consuming two or three more Barbarian Gods of the same size, the quantitative change can reach its limit.

And he can break through the bottleneck, elevating his Divine Sense to twenty-three patterns!

Twenty-three patterns! The peak of Golden Core Early Stage Divine Sense!

It is almost within reach, even seemingly within touch.

Mo Hua’s eyes gleamed.

Once reaching twenty-three patterns, he can do something even more important:

That is to comprehend the unknown, Second Grade twenty-three patterns Taotie Formation within the head of the Shugu Barbarian God Statue!

This is the thing Mo Hua has been most eagerly anticipating these days.

This is an entirely new Ultimate Formation.

What’s even more precious is that the twenty-three patterns Barbarian God Taotie Formation is not the same type of Formation as the Second Grade twenty-four patterns Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation he obtained from the Great Wilderness Evil God Statue.

Both are Taotie Formations, but they feel considerably different to Mo Hua.

The structure of the Formation Patterns and their practical application show obvious differences.

Though they appear different, these two Formations have both used the "Taotie Pattern," falling into the category of the same kind of Four Symbols Taotie Evil Pattern.

This is quite peculiar and has given Mo Hua great insights.

A single Taotie Formation is certainly hard to comprehend.

But if two different Taotie Formations mutually verify each other and interlink, it will necessarily deepen the understanding of Taotie Formation, an Ancient Fierce Beast, and the perception of this kind of Ancient Evil Pattern.

Whether he can learn the Taotie Formation directly affects whether he can forge his Lifebound Formation and whether he can successfully form the Golden Core.

Thus, Mo Hua increasingly yearns for the twenty-three patterns Divine Sense Realm.

He eagerly anticipates the day he can glimpse the essence of the Taotie Formation.

He also looks forward to how potent he can become in terms of Formation if he learns the Taotie Formation.

"Twenty-three patterns..."

To reach twenty-three patterns, naturally, he still needs to consume more.

Mo Hua has assigned tribe management to Dan Zhu, who is doing well, requiring no worry from him.

Thus, Mo Hua currently needs to consider first allowing himself to "consume" to the point of twenty-three patterns.

But the issue lies in that merely relying on himself won’t suffice to consume to twenty-three patterns.

The only place currently offering the chance to consume "Barbarian Gods" is the Shugu Tribe.

The Shugu Tribe is already relatively chaotic, and now a famine has erupted, making it even more chaotic.

A method must be found to attack other Shugu tribes amid the chaos, occupy their Divine Temples, to consume the "Barbarian Gods" they tribute.

The outer tribes and smaller tribes aren’t suitable; they are too weak and cannot provide Third Grade "Great Gods."

It has to be the Shugu subordinate tribes or higher ranked Wandering Tribes.

Only then could he possibly have a "full meal."

But such forces are sure to have Golden Core presence and numerous Barbarian Soldiers.

Alone, Mo Hua cannot conquer towns and villages, and thus he must find allies.

Mo Hua considered for a moment and found Chi Feng of the Golden Core Middle Stage.

Chi Feng is a Barbarian General, also the strongest cultivator in their group in terms of cultivation and combat prowess.

Although Dan Zhu has high talent and superior magic treasures, ultimately, he is still somewhat less experienced in cultivation, age, and battle compared to Chi Feng.

But Mo Hua also knows that Chi Feng might not agree to such "adventurous" endeavors.

...

Inside the Shugu Division Divine Temple.

Mo Hua didn’t shy away and directly told Chi Feng his intentions.

Chi Feng frowned, "Mr. Witch, you wish to... continue campaigning against the Shugu Tribe?"

Mo Hua nodded, "Lord Chi Feng, is there any concern?"

Chi Feng hesitated for a moment, then cautiously reminded:

"The Great Chief tasked me with following Young Master Dan Zhu to ensure his safety and to let him complete his mission and undergo some experiences, not for... undertaking these tasks."

Mo Hua countered, "What else can train a person better than campaigning against the Shugu Tribe?"

Chi Feng gave a wry smile, "That’s not what I meant..."

Such matters are entirely not for Young Master Dan Zhu to handle.

"Moreover," Chi Feng paused slightly, then slowly said, "Mr. Witch, Young Master has been away from the Danque Tribe for some time, it’s about time he returns to the main tribe."

Mo Hua thought to himself, "If you all really went back, how could I lure Dan Zhu out again to fight for my territory?"

Mo Hua calmly said, "No hurry."

Chi Feng frowned, "Mr. Witch, didn’t you say this famine is quite severe? With the current urgent situation, if we don’t return to the main tribe soon, we might encounter unexpected calamities..."

Indeed, Mo Hua had said so.

The famine is indeed urgent.

But precisely because it is urgent, they can’t return now; otherwise they would only await death.

Mo Hua said, "The Divine Lord will guide Young Master Dan Zhu and will bless him. Young Master Dan Zhu will turn misfortunes into blessings."

Chi Feng looked at Mo Hua, silent for a moment, then suddenly said, "Mr. Witch, do you intend to groom and promote Young Master to become the Great Chief?"

This question involves tribal power struggles and is quite sharp.

Mo Hua looked at Chi Feng with a serene gaze, neither confirming nor denying, but replied with a question:

"The Great Chief has four children, Lord Chi Feng, who do you favor?"

Chi Feng said solemnly, "I am of the Great Chief’s people, working only for the Great Chief."

In other words, he will not take sides; whoever becomes the Great Chief has nothing to do with him.

He only needs to perform his duties.

Mo Hua’s eyes were somewhat penetrating, with a smile that wasn’t quite a smile:

"Is this matter really so simple? Does Lord Chi Feng genuinely believe he can remain uninvolved?"

Chi Feng was silent.

Mo Hua continued softly, "Have you not realized that the Great Chief having you guard Young Master Dan Zhu already labels you?"
